data.content: U.S. Men's National Soccer Team. # USMNT projected lineup vs Chile: Will Pochettino rotate his side? The U.S. men's national team looks to make it two wins from two in the post-World Cup era on Tuesday, Sept. 29, as it hosts Chile in St. Louis. In a match that saw 11 players earn their first caps, the USMNT beat Peru 4-1 in Orlando on Saturday, Sept. Two of those debutants, Justin Ellis and Julian Hall, scored in their first USMNT match, while Malik Tillman and Sebastian Berhalter also found the net. With a quick turnaround and two more games after the Chile match, Mauricio Pochettino will likely opt for a healthy amount of rotation on Tuesday at Energizer Park. data.content: # Spain lineup vs. Jon Arnold breaks down a wide-open Ballon d'Or race and why Mbappe, Kane and Yamal each have a strong case for soccer's top individual honor. That moment is now here, and Spain has a daunting start to the European tournament, visiting England after the Three Lions took third place at this summer's World Cup. Much of the squad that helped Spain win the top prize is back, with stars like Lamine Yamal, Ferran Torres and golden ball winner Rodri all present for the match in London. Fullback may be a spot to watch with right back breakout star Pedro Porro out with a hamstring injury and Marcos Llorente having announced his international retirement after the World Cup.
